headline: ALAMOS SLASHES Q2 GUIDE 12% AFTER SEISMIC EVENTS AT YOUNG-DAVIDSON — FULL-YEAR PRODUCTION NOW BELOW LOW END OF 2026 GUIDANCE
source_name: Mining.com / Alamos Gold Inc. (TSX: AGI, NYSE: AGI)
snippet: Alamos Gold Inc. (TSX: AGI) cut Q2 2026 production guidance to 130,000–135,000 ounces on June 18 — approximately 12% below prior guidance — after two seismic events at its Young-Davidson underground mine in Ontario damaged infrastructure and blocked access to higher-grade stopes scheduled for Q2 mining, compounded by a three-day power outage in late May from storm damage to regional power lines. Management now expects full-year 2026 consolidated production to fall below the low end of annual guidance, with a revised full-year outlook due alongside Q2 financial results in late July. Young-Davidson is one of Alamos's three core producing mines; the production impairment there removes a key contributor at a time when gold has corrected more than 25% from its January $5,589/oz all-time high — a double margin squeeze on realized revenue that makes Alamos's next quarterly report a critical catalyst for investors holding the stock through the current sector downturn.

headline: OYU TOLGOI RESUMES IN 24 HOURS — COPPER SLIDES BELOW $6.30 AS MONGOLIA BLOCKADE ENDS; JUNE 30 TARIFF CALL NOW THE KEY DRIVER
source_name: Mining.com / Rio Tinto (ASX: RIO, NYSE: RIO)
snippet: Rio Tinto's Oyu Tolgoi copper mine in Mongolia resumed concentrate exports on June 18, less than 24 hours after the Radical Reform Movement blocked truck transport to the Chinese border — with the company confirming in a social media statement that shipments had returned to normal without disclosing any settlement with protesters. Copper futures slid below $6.30 per pound on the resumption news, reversing the supply-disruption premium that briefly entered the market when the blockade halted one of the world's largest copper-gold operations. The short-lived disruption confirms that Mongolian political risk at Oyu Tolgoi has not been structurally resolved — the underlying revenue-sharing dispute remains active — while simultaneously shifting the copper market's primary near-term catalyst back to the June 30 deadline for the US Commerce Secretary to deliver a Section 232 recommendation on refined copper import tariffs of 15% (2027) and 30% (2028).

headline: KENORLAND + AURANOVA MAKE 'NORTH PAPA' INTRUSION GOLD DISCOVERY IN RED LAKE DISTRICT — 65.5m AT 0.34 g/t IN 7km TARGET FOOTPRINT
source_name: Investing News Network / Kenorland Minerals (TSXV: KLD) + Auranova Resources (TSXV: AURA)
snippet: Kenorland Minerals Ltd. (TSXV: KLD) and Auranova Resources Inc. (TSXV: AURA) announced June 17, 2026 complete Phase 3 assay results from the South Uchi Project in Ontario's Red Lake District — confirming a new large intrusion-related gold system at the 'North Papa' target, defined by gold-mineralised quartz feldspar porphyry with intense silica-sericite-albite flooding and up to 15% pyrite-dominated sulphides in a regional east-west shear zone. Best results include 65.45 metres at 0.34 g/t Au (including 21.0 metres at 0.58 g/t Au) and high-grade shoots up to 9.09 g/t Au across 6 holes totalling 3,187 metres, establishing 1 kilometre of confirmed strike on a 7-kilometre Papaonga target footprint. South Uchi sits in the Birch-Uchi Greenstone Belt, the same structural system hosting the prolific Red Lake gold camp 60 kilometres to the west — and a system-scale intrusion-related discovery with a 7km defined target at the Phase 3 stage, in one of Ontario's highest-grade Archean gold corridors, is the kind of footprint that attracts major company attention in the current $4,150+ gold price environment.

headline: KENORLAND BUYS GOLDEN SIDEWALK FROM PROSPER GOLD FOR $1M — CONSOLIDATES 75,913 HA OF BIRCH-UCHI BELT IN SAME WEEK AS NORTH PAPA DISCOVERY
source_name: GlobeNewswire / Prosper Gold Corp. (TSXV: PGX) + Kenorland Minerals (TSXV: KLD)
snippet: Prosper Gold Corp. (TSXV: PGX) announced June 18, 2026 a definitive agreement to sell its 100% interest in the Golden Sidewalk and Skinner properties — located approximately 60 km east of Red Lake, Ontario — to Kenorland Exploration Ltd. for C$1 million cash, adding the package to Kenorland's Central Uchi Project to form a consolidated block of approximately 75,913 hectares across the Birch-Uchi Greenstone Belt. The transaction follows Kenorland's June 17 announcement of the 'North Papa' intrusion-related gold discovery at South Uchi, making this a same-week dual catalyst: a genuine new district-scale discovery alongside a strategic land consolidation across the same structural corridor. The deal requires Prosper Gold shareholder approval, expected in August 2026. For investors who track greenstone belt consolidation as a precursor to major company interest, Kenorland's Birch-Uchi footprint now covers a land block structurally comparable to the early-stage packages that preceded most historic Ontario gold camp discoveries.

headline: MERCADO MINERALS DRILLS 1,120 g/t AgEq IN SINALOA — INAUGURAL STEP-OUT OPENS SECOND HIGH-GRADE TARGET AT EL AGUA VEIN, COPALITO
snippet: Mercado Minerals Ltd. (CSE: MERC) announced June 18, 2026 new results from its inaugural 3,000-metre diamond drill program at the Copalito Project in Sinaloa, Mexico — intersecting 1.20 metres at 1,120 g/t silver equivalent (34 g/t Ag, 3.40 g/t Au, 19.00% Pb, 21.00% Zn) within a broader 3.50-metre interval of 686 g/t AgEq at 124.75 metres in the El Agua Vein, a step-out hole testing a new, steeper structural interpretation. Earlier results from the 5 Señores Vein established approximately 800 metres of productive strike and 125 metres of vertical depth, with a fault-offset extension adding 250 metres of strike to the southeast. A 1,120 g/t AgEq intercept in the first step-out at a new structural interpretation of El Agua opens a second drill-ready target within the same inaugural campaign — giving investors two active high-grade silver-gold-lead-zinc targets to watch for the remainder of 2026 in a corridor of northern Mexico known for continuous precious metals production since the colonial era.

headline: ANFIELD ENERGY FILES 106% IRR, $606M NPV URANIUM PEA — SHOOTARING CANYON HUB LINKS VELVET-WOOD, SLICK ROCK, AND WEST SLOPE MINES
snippet: Anfield Energy Inc. (TSXV: AEC) filed an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment on SEDAR+ on June 18, 2026 — integrating the Velvet-Wood uranium-vanadium project in Utah, the Slick Rock project in Colorado, and six mines from the West Slope complex into a hub-and-spoke strategy centred on the Shootaring Canyon Mill in southeastern Utah. The PEA shows a 106% pre-tax IRR and US$606 million NPV (8% discount rate) at US$100/lb uranium and US$9/lb vanadium, dropping to 97% IRR and US$533 million NPV post-tax. Shootaring Canyon is one of only a handful of licensed uranium mills in the United States; its combination of operational licence, processing infrastructure, and proximity to multiple Uravan Mineral Belt feed sources is difficult to replicate from scratch. With US uranium spot near $86/lb and utilities under-contracted through the early 2030s, the $100/lb base case represents a near-term re-rating trigger — a licensed US mill with 106% IRR economics sitting roughly 16% above current spot is one of the more precisely defined uranium re-rating catalysts available in the current market.

headline: PREMIER AMERICAN URANIUM HITS U₃O₈ IN 7 OF 19 WYOMING ISR HOLES — 100,000 ft KAYCEE PROGRAM DEFINES POWDER RIVER BASIN OUTPOST ZONE
source_name: GlobeNewswire / Premier American Uranium Corp. (TSXV: PUR)
snippet: Premier American Uranium Corp. (TSXV: PUR) reported June 17, 2026 initial results from its 2026 program at the Kaycee Project in Wyoming's Powder River Basin — with 7 of 19 completed drill holes at the Outpost target intersecting uranium mineralization at grades of 0.02% eU₃O₈ or higher, advancing infill and step-out drilling to expand the zone of known mineralization. The 100,000 ft program targets the Outpost, Rustler, and Stampede areas across a 36-mile mineralized trend hosting more than 110 miles of identified roll fronts within the company's 42-square-mile Kaycee mineral rights package. Wyoming's Powder River Basin is the largest in-situ recovery (ISR) uranium province in the United States, with operating mines and permitted projects already in production — a 36-mile ISR trend in the same basin, advancing through a systematic 100,000-ft campaign with 37% initial hit rate, puts Premier American on the resource-estimate pathway that has historically preceded ISR project financing in this district.

headline: THOMSON: WEEKLY GOLD CHART H&S REVERSAL SIGNALS 'GREATEST RALLY IN HISTORY OF MINERS' IS NOW SETTING UP
snippet: Stewart Thomson, retired Merrill Lynch broker and author of the daily Graceland Updates, argues in his latest GoldSeek column that the weekly gold chart's head-and-shoulders reversal pattern — forming between the January $5,589 all-time high and current $4,150 range — positions gold and gold mining stocks for the greatest rally in the sector's modern history. Thomson combines the technical H&S structure with contrarian sentiment data at extremes: the Gold Miners Bullish Percent Index briefly touching zero, GDX institutional ownership near multi-year lows, and retail allocations collapsed from January highs. The piece frames the hawkish FOMC dot plot's additional selling pressure not as a fundamental bear signal but as the final emotional capitulation needed to complete the pattern's right shoulder — a reading consistent with the well-documented pattern in gold cycles where the deepest post-ATH correction triggers the subsequent bull leg's largest advance. For junior mining investors holding explorers down 40–70% from January, Thomson's framework provides a contrary opinion anchor to balance against consensus summer-doldrums bearishness.

headline: COLLECTIVE MINING TARGETS Q4 ADIT BREAK-GROUND AT GUAYABALES — VETERAN PROJECTS VP NAMED TO DRIVE COLOMBIA PORPHYRY EXECUTION
source_name: Investing News Network / Collective Mining Ltd. (TSX: CNL)
snippet: Collective Mining Ltd. (TSX: CNL) reported June 17, 2026 that detailed engineering studies for the Guayabales Exploration Adit are progressing toward Q4 2026 construction start, with permitting advancing through the relevant Colombian regulatory tracks and an explosives storage facility inspected and approved for compliance. The company also appointed Josué Romanos as Vice President, Projects — a seasoned Colombian projects executive — to lead execution, commissioning, and governance as Guayabales transitions from planning to construction. The adit is the critical-path step to unlocking underground drilling at the deep, high-grade core of the Apollo porphyry system, which cannot be adequately sampled from surface given target depths. With adit construction targeted for Q4 2026 and underground drilling expected to commence in H1 2027, Collective Mining is now in the execution phase of a catalyst sequence that could re-rate the stock from its current discovery-stage range as underground intercepts from Apollo's core begin demonstrating the high-grade tonnage profile that surface drilling has consistently indicated.
